notes: Versioned acceptance corpus for Spatter (#216). Each brief names the production surface it exercises (localGuidance, editSession, exportReceipt), the expected outcome kind and the facts a truthful answer must or must not contain. Version 2 adds the October 13 registry (tween, frame clipboard, project settings, brush families), multi-clause briefs, batches and more hostile inputs. The runner never calls a provider; cloud briefs assert only the composed prompt or local fallback. Failed cases are preserved in the runner's results file with the run seed.

outcomeKinds.localGuide: SpatterAIViewModel.localGuidance returns current guidance containing every mustContain string and no mustNotContain string.
outcomeKinds.applied: SpatterStudioEditSession applies the instruction to a fresh fixture; the receipt fields in requiredReceiptFields must be present.
outcomeKinds.rejected: SpatterStudioEditSession refuses the instruction without changing the document (status rejected or stale).
outcomeKinds.exportReceipt: SpatterExportReceipt is produced from a real file with the listed fields, or refused when the file is missing/mismatched.
